preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of elements n in each test case must be between 2 and 1,000,000.
The number of elements m in set B must be between 1 and n/2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n // 2 for b_i in B)
preconditions.description: Each element b_i in set B must be a positive integer between 1 and n/2.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in array a must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible sum of all a_i after applying the operations.
